text: Lahzga is an Orsimer residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found near the Saddle and Stirrup.
Lagbuga gra-Rug is an Orsimer carpenter residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She runs The Bough and Birdsmouth and can be found there, selling her wares.
Lanobert Emain is a Breton magus and member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Wayrest.
Lanath was an Ayleid hero who set out to hide the Prismatic Crystal in . She recounted her experience in her journal.
Lakene is a Redguard and a mechanic in . He can be seen trying to fix a wagon. He believes that the Septim Empire's research on the Dwemer can lead to many technological advancements.
Lansur is a Khajiit sailor located in the major city on Khenarthi's Roost, Mistral.
Laknar is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk at The Crown's Coster in Sentinel. He has no unique dialogue.
Larhoth is an Orsimer Fighters Guild member residing in the city of Evermore, Bangkorai.

Laughs-at-All is an Argonian comedian residing in the city of Kragenmoor, Stonefalls. He is known for telling jokes, however, he is not very popular among the Dunmer. When he tells a joke regarding their culture, they will generally respond angrily, as they will find the joke offensive.
Laen the Doorwalker is a Bosmer bard performing with her troupe in Silvenar.
Lanilian is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Lamburak is an Orsimer in who resides in the city of Skywatch. She is found with her Frog, Bloodthirster.

Lady Lleraya Montclair is a Breton vampire, and a member of House Montclair. She is the daughter of Baron Wylon Montclair. She was tasked by her father to lead his armies in his stead during his campaign to claim Rivenspire for himself.
Lamoldaire is an Altmer who resides in the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon.
Latif is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel in the Alik'r Desert.
Laelette Eniel is a traveling Breton merchant. She is found on the road south of Hoarfrost Downs.
Laenril the Farstrider is a Bosmer residing in the city of Windhelm.
Larzgug is an Orsimer warrior of the Oathbound Clan found in the Obsidian Scar, Rivenspire.
Lady Moyaltha is a Redguard noble held hostage by the Imperial Legion in her home in Satakalaam.
Lady Sirali at-Tura is a Redguard noble and the mother of Count Hosni.
Lady Valentine Lort is a Breton noble attending to Count Hosni at-Tura's party at his estate.
Laelius Ahala is an Imperial mage of the Legion of the West Weald. He is found at their camp at Senalana.
Laelyn Thielde is a Breton member of the Mages Guild and magister of the guild hall in Kragenmoor.
Laeneval is a Bosmer and one of the survivors of the Daedra attack on Whisper Grove.
Laerinir is a Bosmer soldier and member of the Dominion found in Eagle's Strand.
Laetitia Serre is a Breton who can be found in the outlaws refuge beneath Elden Root.
Lafara is a Nord Vampire sent from The Orchard by the Crimson Matron to participate in The Final Assault against Molag Bal.
Lakurr-ra is a Khajiit beggar found in The Middens of Elden Root.
Landomas is an Altmer bard performing at the Tall Trunk Tavern in Vulkwasten.
Laniriel is a Bosmer found in the Shrouded Vale. Laniriel is married to Erunor.
Lanirsare is an Altmer guild trader selling her wares at the Skystep Stalls in Skywatch.
Lanitaale is an Altmer in who acts as Queen Ayrenn's treasurer.
Lantoine Reynaud is a Redguard laborer found in Daggerfall. He can be found listening to Sir Khnanya at-Salan. He has no unique dialogue.
Lara-Zish is an Argonian found in Dhalmora. She can be found inside Baseenar's House, and has no unique dialogue
Laranette Agnan is a Breton and the innkeeper of The Sloshing Tankard in Northpoint.
Larnil is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers who was captured by the Dominion at the Seaside Sanctuary.
Laroche is a Breton member of the Lion Guard who lost his way in the Bonesnap Ruins.
Lashbesh gra-Shatul is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in the city if Dune, Reaper's March. She can be found at her stall, Waterside Smithy, selling her wares.

Lashburr Tooth-Breaker is an Orsimer shaman of the Iron Orcs clan after he stood against the Scaled Court's influence. He seeks revenge against them and in the process, free his clan of their vicious grip.
Lashdura is an Orsimer residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Lashgikh is an Orsimer looking for her missing husband, Esmaeel, in the Obsidian Scar, Rivenspire.
Last-to-Water is an Argonian miner held hostage by the Stonefire Cult in the Emberflint Mine.
Lathisa Heryon is a Dunmer traveling merchant. She is found on the road near Othrenis.
Laughs-at-Danger is an Argonian found in Darkwater Crossing.
Laughs-at-Turtles is an Argonian drunkard and patron of the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth.
Laura Jascien is a Breton member of the Lion Guard found at their camp near the Dwynnarth Ruins.
Larasel is a Bosmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Lady Slumberbear is a non-hostile lion senche who can be found laying by the edge of the cliff at the Sleepy Senche Overlook in Malabal Tor.
Lanovic Ginise is a Breton member of the Lion Guard residing in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.

Lamazh is an Orsimer mage located at the Orsinium Mages Guild in the city of Orsinium. She is a member of the Mages Guild. When speaking to the Vestige she will give warning that an unusual weather has been reported from the northern shore of Wrothgar.
Lakhalg is an Orsimer traveling merchant who can be found wandering the southern Wrothgar plateu, near Siege Road Wayshrine.
Lafka is a character found in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She cannot be interacted with.
Latelan is a Redguard residing at Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Laeranir is a Bosmer fisher residing in the Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be found at Laeranir's House. She cannot be interacted with.
Lara-Ma is an Argonian entertainer found in the audience hall of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Laronen is an Altmer found in Anvil, Gold Coast. He can be seen walking at the docks.

Lady of the Depths is a powerful Spider Daedra found in the Weaver's Nest inside the Imperial City Sewers. She has taken captives of various races in her lair. She uses the alternate Spider Daedra model with six eyes, no mouth, and horns instead of a crown.
Lashja gra-Bekh is an Orsimer member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale in Rivenspire.
Lakhazga gro-Rimat is an Orsimer defector from the Daggerfall Covenant who can be found at the North Beacon in Auridon.

Lady Sovelle is a Breton ambassador from Daggerfall sent on a diplomatic mission to Orsinium by High King Emeric. She was to be escorted by Captain Henrisa but crashed on the northern coast of Wrothgar under mysterious circumstances.

Laetille is a Breton survivor from the Dark Witnesses attack on Northglen. Although she managed to escape with her life, she fell unconscious in the process and was afflicted with a mysterious sickness threatening to kill her. Members of the Glenmoril Wyrd were tending to her and searching for a way to cure her. Unfortunately, the attempt failed and she turned into a Bloodthorn Zombie.
Lanarette is a Breton that was aboard one of the ships that crashed at the Frozen Fleet.
Larina Jeranus is an Imperial who can be found in the northwestern part of the hedge maze in the city of Kvatch. She cannot be interacted with.
Landalla is a Redguard merchant working at the Leaping Frog Sundries in Abah's Landing.
Lathdur is a Nord beggar residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Larthulf is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.

The Lamia Footsoldier is a lamia that appears in . They are recurring creatures that appear through many quests and locations, and may or may not be hostile. For more information, see the main article.
The Lamia Hurler is a lamia that appears in . They are recurring creatures that appear through many quests and locations, and may or may not be hostile. For more information, see the main article.
Larirmindil is an Altmer noble found outside the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Lady Izza is a Khajiit noble residing in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr.
Lariane Sette is a Breton in who is found drinking by a cooking fire at Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil.
Lady Thorn is a monster set in . It is based on the Lady Thorn from Castle Thorn.
Lagdabash is an Orc residing in Sadrith Mora in Vvardenfell.
Lerexus Callidus is a guardsman in the Imperial Legion. He is standing near Five Riders Stables just north of Leyawiin trying to solicit help in trying to stop some nearby Skooma dealers.
Laythe Wavrick is an Imperial, and the Chief Herald of Chorrol and Countess Arriana Valga's attendant. He can be located in the Castle Chorrol Great Hall.
Legate Rikke is the chief legate of the Imperial Legion under General Tullius. Rikke is a Nord, and strongly believes that Skyrim should be part of the Empire.
Leone is an Imperial Acrobat who resides in Galom Daeus. She is a servant of the vampire Clan Berne.
Legate Skulnar is a Nord warrior and a Legate of the Imperial Legion who resides in the Jarl's Longhouse in Falkreath.
Leifnarr is a deceased Nord farmer in who was killed by a small group of bandits.
Lemkil is a Nord farmer in who lives in the settlement of Rorikstead, where he tends to his farm.

Legate Quentin Cipius is an Imperial Legate of the Imperial Legion. He will relocate inside Dragonsreach after the quest "Message to Whiterun" for the Imperial Legion is completed. As an essential character, he cannot die, even after the Civil War questline has been completed.
Adventus Caesennius is a Legate in the Imperial Legion stationed in Skyrim.

Legate Fasendil is an Altmer Legate in the Imperial Legion. At his own request, Fasendil is stationed in the province of Skyrim by Emperor Titus Mede II to keep an eye on the Thalmor. Fasendil is in charge of the Imperial soldiers at the Rift Imperial Camp. He is an essential character, which means he cannot be killed. If the Rift is taken by the Empire during the Civil War, he will instead be found in Mistveil Keep, located in Riften.
Legate Hrollod is a Nord warrior and a legate of the Imperial Legion. He resides inside a tent in the Eastmarch Imperial Camp.
Legate Taurinus Duilis is the Imperial Legate stationed in the town of Morthal.
Leontius Salvius is an Imperial food vendor, who spends his days chopping wood and helping out at Old Hroldan Inn.
Leigelf is a Nord miner and the owner of Quicksilver Mine in Dawnstar. He can be found outside the mine during the day.
Legate Justianus Quintius was an Imperial Legate and a member of the Tenth Legion. He fought during the Great War until he was wounded in 4E 175. He then went on to write a book titled The Great War.
Legate Emmanuel Admand is a Breton Legate of the Imperial Legion. He is stationed in The Reach’s capital Markarth.
Legate Sevan Telendas is a Dunmer Legate of the Imperial Legion.
Legate Constantius Tituleius is an Imperial Legate of the Legion, and commander of the Imperial forces in The Pale in Skyrim. He has no unique dialogue.
Leonara Arius is an Imperial farmer in who operates the Snow-Shod Farm alongside her husband Addvild.
Leles Birian is a Breton and master trainer of Destruction, who may be found outside Piernette's Farmhouse in the Ascadian Isles region.

Leonce Diel is a Breton found in Glenumbra, High Rock. Although it seems he is part of the investigation of the harpies, his father Lord Alain Diel has started to get back to enjoying the nature around him and do some fishing near his camp. It is located southeast of his father's campsite.
Leclaude Virelande is an Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found inside the Daggerfall Cathedral, listening to Pitof's various sermons.

Leon Milielle is a Breton ghost found in the village of Westtry, Glenumbra. In life, Leon was a devout priest of Stendarr. But, when Nord invaders attacked Westtry, his faith was shaken and it pushed him to turn to Molag Bal for a solution. In doing this, he cursed the town himself, dooming the inhabitants to relive the invasion for eternity.
Lazgar gra-Durog is an Orsimer pauper who resides at Khartag Point during the building of the shrine of Boethiah.
Lena Dalvel is a Dunmer found at the docks of Mournhold and later in Shad Astula. She gives out the Shad Astula Academy Robes after upon completion of the quest "Vision Quest."
Lendonarin is an Altmer noble residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Legdul is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Leana Cantillon is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is the stablemaster and sells her horses at the Saddle and Stirrup.

Len Belland is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra, in . He is first found inside the Crosswych Mine, taken prisoner by the Red Rook Bandits. His wife at the Crosswych Inn is worried about him. He is one of the three prisoners the Vestige rescue during the quest "The Miner's Lament."
Laurina Maria is an Imperial priest working in the Imperial Cult Services inside the Royal Palace at Mournhold. She sells a selection of spells.
Laurosse is an Altmer found in the city of Marbruk who owns a house just outside the city walls. He is betrothed to a Bosmer named Erinel.
Leobois Viliane is a Breton chef residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven. He works at the Cloudy Dregs Inn, near the city's north gate.
Lea Douer is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She has a stall, Market Square Mercantile, in the Wayrest's Merchant District, where she sells her wares.
Ledronor is a Bosmer hunter in Greenshade. He wants to become a member of a group of hunters known as the Hounds of Hircine.
Lereluin is a Bosmer merchant and a member of the Brackenleaf's Briars located in the Grahtwood town of Brackenleaf.
Leaps-Before-Looking is an Argonian residing in the city of Mournhold.
Leo Admand is a Breton pack merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, The Pilgrim's Pouch, at the Belkarth Bazaar in Belkarth.
Layameh is a Redguard alchemist residing in the city of Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in . She can be found at her shop, The Sublime Elixir, selling her wares.
Leifunda is a Nord student found at the ponds of Shad Astula.
Lenonion is a Bosmer residing in the Lower Craglorn Pass in Dragonstar.
Leonce Gavendien, also known as Constable Gavendien, is the leader of the Bitterhand Bandits. He infiltrated the Fell's Run Town Guard by bribing the local mayor.
Leimaer the Raven is a Nord member of the Stormfist Brigade that appears in the Hall of Trials during the quest "One Victor, One King."
Leaves-No-Tracks is an Argonian residing in the town of Chorrol.
Lepida Polus is an Imperial fisher residing in Port Hunding. She can found working around the docks, and has no unique dialogue.
Laurisac Vien is a Breton miner who worked at the Kulati Mines before Spiders invaded the place.
Lazami is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Leaks-When-Struck is an Argonian brewer working at The Withered Tree in Riften.
Learns-Through-Pain is an Argonian worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Leel-Vata is an Argonian and the spiritual leader of kin in the Silent Mire.
Legionary Mincarione is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion in who works under Captain Ciranya's unit at the South Beacon.
Legionary Norfando is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion in who serves under Captain Ciranya at the South Beacon. When they were beset by Sea Vipers, he was captured.
Legionary Pandetuile is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion in who is currently in Captain Ciranya's unit at the South Beacon on Auridon.

Legionary Tanacar is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion in who works under Captain Ciranya's unit at the South Beacon in Auridon. He can be found lying wounded on the beach in the northern part of South Beacon. He has been injured by Sea Vipers.
Legionary Uulion is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion in who works under Captain Ciranya's unit at the South Beacon.
Legodir the Daunted is a Bosmer found at the Dragonstar Arena.
Leiddrod is a Nord weaponsmith and member of the Ebonheart Pact. residing at the Southern Morrowind Gate. She works and smells her wares at the smithy at the Southern Morrowind Gate.

Leidela Black-Briar is a Nord of the Black-Briar family, and an influential member of Riften's society. Her son, Jomarr, acts as her bodyguard. She is one of the many contacts of former Eye of the Queen and Aldmeri Dominion traitor Krin Ren-dro.
Lejesha is a Redguard guild trader selling her wares at her kiosk, Last Chance Lejesha's, located south of the Bergama Wayshrine.
Lekellae Caprenia is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch in Haven.
Lenel Beryon is a Dunmer in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards. He is waiting for Famdii who can be found under the docks lounging with Giiril.
Lennald is a Nord patron of the Coin Brothers' Cornerclub in Stormhold.
Lenning the Hawk is a Nord and the organizer of the Footrace of the Nine Holds, a part of The Konunleikar, taking place in Windhelm.
Lennoc Barthel is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Velyn Harbor.
Leta Doniticus is an Imperial member of the Blackcaster Mages Guild found in Elinhir. She is one of Archmage Yamanu-ko's apprentices.
Lenwe is an Altmer laborer who has fallen victim to the plague found in Phaer, and so cannot be spoken with. Lenwe is the author of Letter from Lenwe.
Leonique Gelves is a Breton found at the Cold Iron Forge in the Hollow City.
Leono Draconis is an Imperial and one of the co-owners, along with his wife Rasala, of the Applewatch Inn.
Leonora Mantel is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Daggerfall.
Lepida Sophus is an Imperial guard protecting a group of priestesses of Mara found near Fort Sphinxmoth.
Lerangalion is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion found in Eagle's Strand.
Lermion is an Altmer drunkard residing in Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Lesmaral is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp outside Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. She is found in a tent located near Thoda's Home.
Lessa Frostfang is a Reachman member of the Rageclaw Clan found inside Fallowstone Hall.
Lazum-dar is a non-hostile black senche who can be found sitting by the edge of the cliff at the Sleepy Senche Overlook in Malabal Tor.
Lerangor is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Lenoril is a Bosmer Bard residing in the town of Morkuldin Haven, Wrothgar. He plays a lute at Orzorga's Kitchen there.
Lazghal is an Orsimer residing in Chief Abzug's Longhouse in the Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Laurette Riscel is a Breton residing in the Barracks House in Wayrest. She is sheltering from the Dreugh attack. She has no unique dialogue.
Lengaer is a Bosmer brewer found in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Laurri is a Khajiit commoner found in the east halls of the castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Lejafah is a Redguard found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Leonhard Nathans is a Breton found in the east halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Lepida Melitus is an Imperial found in Anvil. She can be seen at the docks, by Laeranir's House, sometimes talking to Flavia Russus. She cannot be interacted with.

Legate Cassia was an Imperial Legate during the Great War between the Third Aldmeri Dominion and the Third Empire. She joined the Forgotten Hero during his quest to aid the Empire, after the Hero had taken down a group of Imperial Deserters. With the company of the Hero and his followers, they went to the Imperial City, posing as Gladiators, to find out the source of Naarifin's power. During the Battle of the Red Ring, Cassia commanded a part of the Imperial forces.
Lenet Beriel is a Breton fisherman found at the docks near Murcien's Hamlet.
Lesuin is a Reachman found at Arcwind Point. He was put in a cage and left to freeze by the Worm Cult members there after he refused to partake in their rituals.
Legate Gallus is an Imperial officer of the Imperial Legion. He is found in the Memorial District of the Imperial City.
Lenaninwe is an Altmer noble residing in Windhelm, Eastmarch. She is one of the celebrants of the Konunleikar. She has no unique dialogue.
Lecalus is a Wispmother in . She has made her lair within Hrota Cave in Gold Coast.
Legionnaire Andwulf is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is in Pa'alat, sent to do dealing with former Eye of the Queen and Aldmeri Dominion traitor Krin Ren-dro.
Len is a Dunmer commoner residing in the Ahemmusa Camp, on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Ledda is a Dunmer commoner and Ashlander residing in the Erabenimsun Camp in Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.

Laurig, or Chief Laurig, is an Orsimer of the Shatul Clan residing in Shatul Range, Wrothgar. Laurig was once the chief of his own clan until the Reachmen destroyed it; after this disastorous event, Chief Ogzor, of the echatere-herding Clan Shatul next to his, offered him a place in the clan. Life continued normally for him until Ogzor's untimely death in a battle against Urgkail the Cleaver, a giant that terrorized his clan.
Lesspa is a Khajiit that appears in . She is the head of the F'aashe clan.
Lector Tanel Sadyron is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Lector Trivura is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Mechanical Fundament in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. __NOTOC__
Laurisac Vien is a Breton miner that worked the Kulati Mines before it was invaded by spiders.
Lehrsjon is a dog found wandering near Akovor's house, southwest of Piukanda. His owner is Akovor himself.
Lea Jeanne is the Breton alchemist of the Town in . She is from the town of Wind Keep in High Rock.
Lepida Atronia is an Imperial commoner who appears in Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr. She can be found near the stables carrying barrels back and forth and has no dialogue.
Lernyelel is an Altmer residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Leiborn is a Nord residing in the Bards College in Solitude.
Leramil the Wise is a character in that was introduced as part of the prologue for the DLC. She is a scholar who occasionally runs errands for the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora.
Lejikeh is a Redguard located in Dhalmora, Bal Foyen, in . She is only present during the Jester's Festival event and wears a purple and gold banquet garb.
Lazdutha is an Orc located in Morkul Stronghold. She is an ambassador for the king of Orsinium.
Leona Blasio is an Imperial residing in Molag Mar in Vvardenfell.
Lector Erisia is a Redguard Ghost residing in The Shadow Cleft.
Ley Marillin runs the The King and Queen Tavern in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. Marillin rents beds for 10 and sells food.
Levus Musilchiotus is an Imperial Agent who resides in Morrowind. Levus is hostile towards the Nerevarine and will attack on sight, but will offer training if they manage to speak to him.
Leyawiin Soldier is an Imperial soldier. He appears to help with the Defense of Bruma if help is sought from Leyawiin during Allies for Bruma.
Lette is a Redguard Commoner who resides in Tel Mora. She isolates herself on the northern outskirts of the city, fearful of infecting others with the Swamp Fever that plagues her.
Levaia is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp outside Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. She is found in a tent near Thoda's Home.
Licks-Longfins is an Argonian residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Licks-the-Sand is an Argonian residing near the crates outside the Hlan House in Quarantine Serk.
Liane is a Breton residing in the Baandari Trading Post. She has come there as a trader along with her husband Feluz, but he lost his way.
Librarian Sharuk is an Orsimer residing in the city of Shornhelm.
Lia Korine is a Breton residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs. She is a cattle wrangler.
Letta is a Redguard found at Ogre's Bluff in the Alik'r Desert. She is part of a caravan that was attacked by giant snakes while on its way to Bangkorai.
Li'l Rilis is a cat who can be found on a counter inside the Skywatch Mages Guild. He is one of many cats residing at the Skywatch guild.
Licinia Prentus is an Imperial found inside the castle of Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Lianorien is a Bosmer guild trader. She sells her wares at her stall, Lianorien's Outpost, in Orsinium.

Librarian Bradyn is a Dunmer librarian who manages the Library of Vivec in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. He has been composing a map of Vvardenfell from rubbings found across ancestral tombs on the island, in search of the Library of Andule.
Leyla Ronen is a Dunmer beggar residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell.
Letine Arese was an assistant to minister Hierem. She secretly worked as an spy for Emperor Titus Mede I.

Leythen is a former member of the Psijic Order and husband of Valsirenn. His daughter died from some kind of disease and a shrine was built by them on Artaeum after her death. Afterwards, Leythen betrayed the Psijic Order, joined the Court of Bedlam, and became Earl of Mephala. Before the quest starts, he can be seen in the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, pretending to be Lord Thenley.
Lidyeilah is a Redguard found sweeping in the Great Chapel of Dibella's office in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Lhort is a Redguard guard in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Llaalam Dredil is a Dunmer living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion and an advisor to Duke Dren.
Lillith Maiden-Loom is an elderly Nord and an acquaintance of Maven Black-Briar.
Lisbet is a Nord who runs the Arnleif and Sons Trading Company in Markarth. During the Daedric quest "The Taste of Death", she is revealed to be a cannibal and a member of the Coven of Namira.

Limark was a Redguard knight who resided in the Shivering Isles. Limark, at some point, killed himself and his soul is cursed to walk the Hill of Suicides; the only way to be freed is if somebody finds his skull and returns it. Limark's skull is found in the ruins of Milchar.
Lieutenant Salvarus is an Imperial soldier and member of the Penitus Oculatus.

Lifts-Her-Tail is a character from the book The Lusty Argonian Maid, A Song and its sequels. She is an Argonian maid employed by a married man named Crantius Colto, who is infatuated with her, and seeks to have intimate relations with her. She makes several double entendres while doing housework, which Crantius Colto simply uses as a way to encourage sexual behavior.
Lirielle Stoine is a Breton Thief and owner of The Rat in the Pot in Ald'ruhn. She works for the Thieves Guild as a Wet Ear, and also is a Skill Trainer and Merchant.
Llanel Brenos is a Dunmer working for House Redoran as a Hireling. He can be found in Llethri Manor in Ald'ruhn.
Llaalsa Dralor is a Dunmer bandit residing in the cave Adanumuran in the Ascadian Isles.
Llanas Drilvi is a Dunmer witchhunter, and resides in the cave of Ainat.
Llandrale Varam is a Dunmer Mage residing in the ruins of Ald Sotha.
Llandris Thirandus is a Dunmer enchanter who resides in Vivec City, Temple Canton.
Llarar Bereloth is a Dunmer sorcerer and a member of House Telvanni residing in Sulipund.
Llarara Omayn is a Dunmer priest who resides in the Temple in Balmora.

Lielle Vette is a Breton spellsword and member of House Telvanni who resides in Mababi, in the Molag Amur region of Morrowind. She is hostile to the Nerevarine unless they are also a member of House Telvanni.
Liesl is a Nord sailor found indoctrinated under Miraak's control on Solstheim.

Littrek Earth-Turner is a Nord in who is the son of Aera and Denskar Earth-Turners, and he has one sister, Trynhild. He was forced to flee his home in Bleakrock Village with the rest of the residents when Daggerfall Covenant forces ransacked the place. Once he reached the safety of Bal Foyen, he joined the Ebonheart Pact like many of the other refugees.
Lieutenant Harim is a Redguard residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He is one of the Lion Guards and is first met when the Duke of Camlorn has been kidnapped.

Lieutenant Dubois is a Breton member of the Daggerfall City Guard. He has been dismissing the poor when they ask for help but after the quest "Back-Alley Murders," he promises to listen to everyone if they are in trouble.
Liezl is a Nord boatswain that offers transport between Davon's Watch, Bleakrock Village and Dhalmora.
Lieutenant Marlene is a deceased Breton found in the village of Westtry, High Rock. She was the one who led the defense of the town against the Nord invaders.
Lieutenant Clarice is a Redguard member of the Lion Guard residing in a small camp near the town of Westtry, Glenumbra.
Lieutenant Gustave is a Breton residing in Glenumbra. He's found with two other guards and he is referring to the events in the quest "The White Mask of Merien."

Linus Iulus is a deceased Imperial pilgrim who met his demise on the peak of Mount Kand. He can be found above the entrance to Mount Kand Cavern between two large stone formations, usually with one or more Cliff Racer near or above his skeletal remains.
Lion Guard Soldier is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.
Lieutenant Kazargi is a Khajiit member of the Haven City Guard.
Lihidar at-Shadal is a Redguard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She's found in the Fighters Guild.
Lisolda Bezons is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Wayrest.
Lisanne Virane is a Breton banker, working in the Wayrest Treasury in Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Liiril Morvayn is Dunmer fisher found at Davon's Watch's dockyards. He has no unique dialogue.

Lieutenant Samaea-do is a Khajiit sitting close to a fireplace at the Temple of the Crescent Moon. Her family lives on the northern part of the island. She was one of the first who went to the mainland, and after war broke out she joined the Dominion military forces. She came back to her birthplace in the hope to see her family and to visit plantations. She does not like that she is also coming back for military reasons.
Llarevis Virian is a Dunmer residing in the city of Mournhold.
Lights-Sparks is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Mournhold.
Lieutenant Ehran is an Altmer member of the Fist of Thalmor. He is tasked with leading the defense of Velyn Harbor against the Ra Gada invaders.
Lithyyorion is a character residing in the city of Evermore.
Lieutenant Jolias is a named bandit found in Delfran's Hideout in . Jolias possesses Key B, used to enter Delfran's throne room.
Lieutenant Breser is a named bandit found in Delfran's Hideout in . Bresar possesses Key A, used to enter Delfran's throne room.
Llandryn Gilvilo is a Dunmer residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Lingonir is an Altmer residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Llanvyn Indaren is a Dunmer brewer. He is found inside the arch-mage's office in Shad Astula.
Linyon is an Altmer laborer in who resides in the city of Skywatch. He can be overheard conversing with Eardir.
Lieutenant Rarili is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. She serves as a guard in Narsis.
Lily Bordier is a Breton chef. She is working at the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Lisien Motierre is a Breton residing in the town of Chorrol.
Lillie is a guar residing in the region of Bal Foyen. He is a member of Esqoo's Guar herd, who considers them to be his family.
Limdathir is a Redguard drinking in The Screaming Mermaid Lodge in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He has no unique dialogue.
Lieutenant Stenric is a Breton member of the Lion Guard found in The Lion's Den. Killing him counts towards the "Pride of The Lion's Den" and "Slayer of The Lion's Den" achievements.
Lieutenant Curinaire is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion on security detail at their embassy in Elden Root. She is the author of Sgolag.
Lieutenant Adeline is a Breton member of the Lion Guard found at their camp near Eagle's Brook.
Lieutenant Aldononde is an Altmer officer of the Aldmeri Dominion, and part of the invading force at the Hatching Pools during the quest "Keepers of the Shell."
